title: Arrays To Connections in Target Schema
description: Replace entity list fields with Relay Connection types in target.schema.graphql; only arrays remain inside Connection.edges (plus ID slice inputs where needed).
summary: All entity collection fields now use Relay connection outputs (`FooConnection!`); attribute blobs use `AttributeListingConnection!`. Added `BlueprintEdge`/`BlueprintConnection` for union `Blueprint` replaceables and `OperationEdge`/`OperationConnection` for Change forwards/backwards and Operation-hosted slices. Registered Blueprint*/Operation* in aggregate unions alongside existing connections. Kept `[OperationEdge!]`-style arrays only inside `EntityConnectionInterface` implementations, `[ID!]` only where identifiers must batch (`pieceIds`, `bestRepresentation(tagIds)`). graphql-core parse and cargo test pass.
